notes: HISTORY.md records declare no claim_status frontmatter (their DEVELOPMENT companions carry Argued); the kicker therefore reads "<record_id> · HISTORY" rather than inventing a status. Binding claim_status is null for these.
Italic relations = the record's own frontmatter movement_ids (capped with +n more in the card; exact list here) + domain.
Packet record history-language-law-nation-centralisation maps to the twelve-situated-histories tree (places-and-peoples); packet record history-myth maps to encounters-and-transmissions/myth.
Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (records re-read at fc59a719 under submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/histories/…/HISTORY-*.md):

Grammar: each trunk formation sequences the record's OWN section headers verbatim, in the record's order — the station row stays, the stream now runs. Six of ten histories carry sequences (ancient, indian, mathematics, myth, process-systems, psychology, zero-subject, law-nation, symbol-dialogue: 9 total).

history-mathematics: THE 3D SCENE — the five stations distributed in z from +0.42 (absence acquires an office, furthest) to −0.42 (mathematics enters the machine, nearest); depth means time: the stream runs toward the reader, the trunk walking its five sections with deepening tint. depthPerspective+occlusion+tint authored.

Pointers carry era-character: ancient repel (form holds the finite), indian vortex (differentiation), law-nation repel/shove (centralisation's force), symbol-dialogue attract (dialogue gathers), mathematics attract (generators), myth vortex/vortex (genealogy's traffic), process-systems vortex (recurrent pattern), psychology attract/implode (the field gathers), technology-politics repel/shove (preference enforced), zero-subject attract/implode (the advent gathers).

Tints walk era-kettle: earth/sand for antiquity and transmission, moss for the living lines, rust for centralisation and technē, violet for the psychoid, ink for the arrived machine — presentation accents, no new claims.
history-myth body compressed to ≤70 words (no claim changed: 'born to' → 'of', 'the essay's reading' → 'the reading').
Beats: durations 12–15s, transitions 1.6–2.5; 3 automation lanes (mathematics stream light, myth genealogy pulse, psychology field drift); layouts line on the four station-row scenes.

Craft rework 2026-10-07 (expression rework pass, lane 5; records re-read at fc59a719). The histories are now drawn as chronicle streams: a stream band runs across each scene, station rings mark the record's own sections in order along it, and the trunk walks station to station with the sections verbatim — the walks, their order and their tint walks are carried byte-exact from the previous grammar (rationales keep mapping each section text). Each era draws its own figure beside the stream: antiquity's held form and differentiating field, the tree's centralising press, dialogue's joined sign, mathematics' empty place set deepest in the kept 3D scene (stations distributed in z, depth meaning time), myth's forked branch, process's recurrent ring, psychology's gathering field, technē's enforced preference, and the zero opening at dawn. The papers move through temperature — parchment, grey-green, cold, cream, lilac, rose, dawn — with grounds shared inside eras (antiquity, the transmission pair, myth-with-process): the stillness is the era holding while its sections walk. Stage text is one hospitable sign-name per history plus a single opening line (17 words).

Deepen pass 2026-10-07 (second movement, lane 5; records re-read at fc59a719). DEPTH — history-mathematics' standing 3d scene is kept (the stream's stations distributed in z, the empty place set deepest); its field depth now 0.55 — the chronicle stream runs through volume, and 'a place must be readable before it can operate' is read as depth: the empty place works because the practice can reach into it. ALIVE — one morph scene on history-mathematics: engine.morphEnabled with trajectory toroidalHopf and sine drive; morph law theta at thetaRate 0.1 / phiRate 0.06 — the slowest law in the family: the kept place turns gently under one law while the stream holds its stations, changed permissions over retained conditions. Seven physics profiles across the daylight chronicles (props vary across states, hold within rests): parchment antiquity shared by ancient and indian (grain 0.04, halo 0.12, softness 0.2, irregularity 0.42 — the softest paper in the corpus); legal grey shared by the tree and dialogue (grain 0.026, halo 0.08, elongation 0.18, contrast 0.97 — the hardest, most directional strokes); mathematics slate (grain 0.032, halo 0.1, depth 0.55); myth warm shared by myth and process (grain 0.046, halo 0.18, roundness 0.82, irregularity 0.48); psychology lilac (grain 0.05, halo 0.22, roundness 0.78, irregularity 0.54); technē rust (grain 0.03, halo 0.09, elongation 0.16); advent cream (grain 0.038, halo 0.15, depth 0.4). Rest pairs hold: antiquity–emptiness, tree–dialogue, myth–process. TITLES — every scene title is the record's own line: 'Agreement within the differing' (the Heraclitus heading), 'Finite powers and the return of recognition' (the record's title), 'Twelve situated histories' (the record's title), 'The account answers back' (the record's title), 'Changed permissions and retained conditions' (the record's title), 'Tellings, changed offices, consequential return' (the record's title), 'Different histories enter a common question' (the record's heading), 'Formation, symbolic transformation, return of responsibility' (the record's title), 'Formation, delegation and return' (the record's title), 'An advent changes what can be said' (the record's heading). STEP-SCALE — all 50 text-changing steps drop objectState entirely; same-text steps of non-text formations keep complete objectStates (the stream's station holds).
